quest.title: Brook the Carnivore
quest.description: Springvale's Brook requires six servings of Raw Meat.

talks.objective: Give Brook six servings of Raw Meat

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need some Raw Meat?

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Oh, you must have seen that commission of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Well, do you have six servings of Raw Meat with you?

response.speaker: Brook
response.text: Well, I'll need them to research new recipes, so please pass them to me once you've gathered them all.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Oh my, these cuts are very good indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Thank you very much for your help. Here's a little something in return.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Come over when I'm done with my research — you'll be the first to try my new dish, I promise.
